name: Seared Steak with Green Chermoula and Chickpea Salad

cookwares.name: large cast iron or stainless steel skillet

ingredients.name: extra-virgin olive oil, plus more if needed

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse the chickpeas. Finely chop the red onion. Finely chop the tender stems of the cilantro leaves. Finely chop the tender stems of the flat-leaf parsley leaves. Finely chop the fresh mint. Finely chop the fresh dill. Finely mince or grate the garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (15 oz) cans chickpeas
1 small red onion
1 cup cilantro leaves
1 cup flat-leaf parsley leaves
¼ cup fresh mint
2 tbsp fresh dill
2 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: For the Steak: Pat steaks dry with paper towels. Season liberally and evenly with salt. For better salt penetration, let steak sit at room temperature for at least 40 minutes or uncovered in the refrigerator overnight.

For the Chickpea Salad: In a medium bowl, whisk together oil, lemon juice, cumin, coriander, and salt until well combined. Add chickpeas, onions, and parsley, and toss to combine. Refrigerate until the flavors meld, about 30 minutes.
For the Green Chermoula: In a medium bowl, whisk together oil, lemon juice, cilantro, parsley, mint, dill, garlic, garlic, cumin, coriander, and salt. Refrigerate until ready to use.

For Cooking the Steak: In a large cast iron or stainless steel skillet, heat oil until just smoking. Carefully add steak and cook, pressing the thicker part down with an offset spatula, small pan, or cooking weight, and flipping every 30 seconds, until a pale golden-brown crust starts to develop, about 4 minutes total. Continue to cook, flipping steak occasionally, basting any light spots with fat from the pan, and pressing the thicker part down with an offset spatula or cooking weight until it develops a deeply browned crust and an instant-read thermometer inserted into thickest part of steak side registers 120 to 125°F (49 to 52°C) for medium-rare or 130°F for medium, 2 to 8 minutes total. Transfer to a wooden board and allow to rest for 10 minutes.
To Serve: Slice steak against the grain to desired thickness. Spoon some chermoula over warm steak slices and serve with chickpea salad and remaining chermoula on the side.

schema_metadata.keywords: steak, chermoula, green chermoula, chickpea salad, steak salad

description: This seared steak with chermoula and a lemony chickpea salad is a fresh, balanced dinner that comes together in an hour.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 1 hr 10 min.

Optional substitutions: flank steak → skirt steak or sirloin steak

Make-ahead and storage: Chickpea salad can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 4 days.
Chermoula can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 2 days before using. Note that the herbs will darken a bit as it sits.
Leftover steak can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 3 days.
author: Nargisse Benkabbou
